dimensions.name: Governance Awareness
dimensions.rationale: Every reasoning step in the pattern extraction flow executed cleanly under its assigned contract and validated successfully against its designated schema (rule_context_schema, agentic_patterns_catalogue_schema, and structural_patterns_catalogue_schema) without policy failures.

dimensions.name: Causal Reasoning Depth
dimensions.rationale: The pipeline maintained strict causal linkage from contextual rules loading through downstream agentic and structural pattern extractions, preserving domain constraints cleanly across distinct extraction contexts.

dimensions.name: Architectural Tension Analysis
dimensions.rationale: Effectively decoupled dynamic agentic behavioral patterns from static structural patterns while handling substantial token output volumes within schema boundaries.
